source.note: common.md (Diagram detection): read once more with the comment line left out, `%%{`, whitespace, and `wrap}%%` form a closed directive that detection skips; the position reached is at `---`, so the `---` pseudo-diagram rejects the text, as in mermaid.js.

error.name: Error
error.message: Diagrams beginning with --- are not valid. If you were trying to use a YAML front-matter, please ensure that you've correctly opened and closed the YAML front-matter with un-indented `---` blocks
